description: Congressman Juan Ciscomani has been endorsed by Citizens for Responsible Energy Solutions (CRES), part of the organization's first round of 2026 congressional endorsements. title: Citizens for Responsible Energy Solutions Endorses Congressman Juan Ciscomani for Re-Election — Juan Ciscomani for Congress
